node.title: Re: DateTime issues
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I apologize, I initially made an oversight in [id://11114923|my reply] to your previous question. $now->add( years=>1 ) actually modifies the $now object and returns the same object. Use $now->clone->add(...) to get a modified copy of $now instead.

Edit: Improved wording.
